meta.title: feat: add caching layer for frequent identical requests
meta.body_summary: Add Redis-based caching for identical LLM chat requests, configurable per-project with API toggles and UI preferences.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added Redis-based caching across gateway, API, UI, and DB; merged without review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1916 changed lines across 43 files, this is a large edit by absolute volume, though much is merge-related boilerplate and UI additions. Despite the scale, the PR merged without review, suggesting maintainer trust in a complete caching feature addition.

review_details.performance_claim: Reduce redundant processing of identical LLM requests via Redis-based caching.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Multi-layer caching implementation across backend, database, and frontend. Agent delivered a complete feature set that merged without review, demonstrating capability in cross-cutting infrastructure changes.

maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR merged without any reported regressions.

core_change_summary.description: Added Redis-based caching for identical chat requests in gateway/src/lib/cache.ts, project caching configuration in API content/projects.ts, DB schema extension, UI caching settings in settings, and related hooks/components.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge conflict resolution brought in unrelated changes like date-range-select, organization, passkey components, and recent-logs refactor.
change_trajectory: Initial cache implementation: Redis cache (cache.ts), project caching configuration (projects.ts), chat route integration (chat.ts), DB schema change.
Added caching settings UI (caching-settings.tsx) and hooks (useDefaultProject, useProject).
Moved caching settings to Preferences tab.
Refactored mutations and cache key generation.
Resolved merge conflicts with main, bringing in large unrelated changes.
Updated useDefaultProject to fetch real data, fixed endpoint path.
